catalog_seller_id.description: Parameter defines the Walmart seller to get results for. It's the number after `/seller/` in the seller page link (e.g., `101025813` in `https://www.walmart.com/seller/101025813`), and the `catalog_seller_id` in our Walmart Search API, Walmart Product API, and Walmart Product Sellers API results, not their `seller_id`.

sort.description: Parameter defines the sorting of the seller's products. It defaults to `best_match`. Available options: `best_match` - Best match `price_low` - Price: low to high `price_high` - Price: high to low `best_seller` - Best seller `rating_high` - Highly rated `new` - New arrivals

facet.description: Parameter defines items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `||`. The key and value are separated by `:` (e.g., `brand:Sony||color:Black`).

page.description: Parameter defines the page number. Walmart returns up to `40` products per page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Maximum page value is `100`, while the `pagination` and `serpapi_pagination` links stop at page `25`, like Walmart's. Use sort and facet to reach more of a large seller's products.

engine.description: Set parameter to `walmart_seller` to use the Walmart Seller API engine.

no_cache.description: Parameter will force SerpApi to fetch the Walmart Seller results even if a cached version is already present. A cache is served only if the query and all parameters are exactly the same. Cache expires after 1h. Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month. It can be set to `false` (default) to allow results from the cache, or `true` to disallow results from the cache. no_cache and async parameters should not be used together.

async.description: Parameter defines the way you want to submit your search to SerpApi. It can be set to `false` (default) to open an HTTP connection and keep it open until you got your search results, or `true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retrieve them later. In this case, you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results. async and no_cache parameters should not be used together. async should not be used on accounts with Ludicrous Speed enabled.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise only. Parameter enables ZeroTrace mode. It can be set to `false` (default) or `true`. Enable this mode to skip storing search parameters, search files, and search metadata on our servers. This may make debugging more difficult.

api_key.description: Parameter defines the SerpApi private key to use.

output.description: Parameter defines the format of the result. It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results, `html` to get the raw HTML retrieved, or `md` to get a Markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

include_filters.description: Include `filters` to the JSON response. Set to `true` to enable or `false` to disable (default).
